pages.title: Pyrite
pages.text: Pyrite, also called fool's gold, is a decorative $(l:mechanics/gems)gemstone$(). It occurs below Y=70 in intrusive and extrusive igneous rocks.

pages.title: Ruby
pages.text: Ruby is a decorative $(l:mechanics/gems)gemstone$(). It is rarely found in marble below Y=-10 and is more common in marble belts within collisional mountains.

pages.title: Sapphire
pages.text: Sapphire is a decorative $(l:mechanics/gems)gemstone$(). It can be found in the rock fissures surrounding hot springs.

pages.title: Topaz
pages.text: Topaz is a decorative $(l:mechanics/gems)gemstone$(). It can be found in lava fissures associated with volcanoes and tuyas.
